title: Chromatic-Menu
summary: A fast, locked-down desktop launcher for internet cafés, gaming lounges, and coin-operated PC rentals, with an optional web dashboard that shows which PCs are on, what they are used for, and an estimate of what they earn.

story.heading: Launcher
items: Tabs of programs: group games and apps into tabs with icons; add .exe, .lnk, .bat, .cmd, websites, and folders.
Drag and drop: reorder items, move them between tabs, or drop files from Explorer to add them.
Broken shortcut detection: missing targets are flagged on the card and blocked from launching with a clear message.
Right-click menu: Run, Run as administrator, Open file location, Properties.
Search across all tabs.

story.heading: Header Panels
items: Live hardware info: computer name, CPU, RAM, disks (SSD / HDD / NVMe), OS build, cores and threads, network up/down speed, GPU and VRAM (refreshes every 3 seconds).

Technical tools: Control Panel, Uninstall Programs, File Explorer, Network Connections, Device Manager, Disk Management, Services, Task Manager, Command Prompt, Windows Settings, System Information, and Request a Game.

story.heading: Admin & Kiosk Behavior
items: Password-protected Settings and Edit Mode: with a forced password change on first use.
Session lock toggle: with a visible Locked / Unlocked indicator.
Kiosk windowing: borderless and maximized, respects the taskbar; the X button and Alt+F4 only minimize.

story.heading: Deep Freeze Awareness & Updates
items: Deep Freeze detection: detects whether the PC is Boot Frozen or Thawed.
Check for Updates (Settings › About): downloads the latest MSI from GitHub Releases and installs it, but only when the PC is Thawed, so an update is never lost on reboot.

story.heading: Appearance
items: Customization: flat dark and light themes, accent colors, custom colors, fonts with 0.8x to 1.4x scaling, and a custom wallpaper.

story.heading: Backup & Portability
items: Configuration: saved atomically in data\config.json with a .bak copy.
Export / Import: a ZIP of the config and assets to copy a setup across other PCs.

title: RBX Server Manager
summary: A 100% client-side, zero-dependency static web application designed to track, resolve, and 1-click launch Roblox game servers across any game with instant short-code resolution and a direct session bridge.

story.heading: 100% Game-Agnostic Server Discovery
items: Zero hardcoded locks: universal design allows entering any custom Roblox Place ID or saving custom game profiles with a single click.
Live instance scanning: dynamically scans active public servers, real-time player counts, capacity, and network ping (ms).
Smart filtering: sort instances by lowest players, lowest ping, smart match, or highest player density.

story.heading: Instant Server Joiner & Short-Code Auto-Resolution
items: Short-code auto-resolution: paste 8-character server codes (e.g. 27eb-4606 or 27eb4606) or full 36-character UUIDs.
Direct 1-click launch: resolves target instances and launches the client without reloading or navigating away from the dashboard.
Instance bookmarks: pin and label persistent instances for quick return access.

story.heading: Direct Session Bridge
items: Client-side bridge: connects through a lightweight browser userscript (Tampermonkey / Violentmonkey) directly into authenticated Roblox sessions.
No proxy server needed: requests run inside the user's own logged-in browser session, so there's no backend to host.

story.heading: Multi-Theme Glassmorphism Bento UI
items: Modular Bento layout: clean, glassmorphic card architecture displaying player meters, ping indicators, and copyable server codes.
Curated themes: native support for Dark Void, Cyber Neon, Emerald, and Clean Light aesthetic profiles.

title: Sapphire+
summary: A comprehensive, modular SuperBLT modification for PAYDAY 2 that modernizes loot carry mechanics, expands solo stealth capabilities, eliminates pre-planning budget constraints, and provides a customizable in-game menu.

story.heading: Stealth & Infiltration Enhancements
items: Multi-pickup keycards & consumables: enables stacking mission items (Keycards, Planks, C4, Thermite) in inventory without vanilla limitations, allowing solo completion of multi-keycard objectives like the Shadow Raid vault.
Infinite camera loops: extends tape loop duration to 99,999 seconds, fully synchronized with HUD timer overlays and Extra Heist Info (EHI).

Minimum detection risk: forces detection risk to the engine minimum (3 Detection Risk / 0.0 suspicion offset) regardless of equipped ICTV armor or heavy weapons, granting maximum Sneaky Bastard and Low Blow bonuses.
Pager & alarm controls: includes AI alarm prevention, configurable random pager removal sliders (1% to 100%), and automatic instant pager answering.

story.heading: Carry Weight & Mobility Mechanics
items: Sprint & carry overhaul: sprint freely at full speed while carrying gold, artifacts, or nuclear warheads, eliminating vanilla bag movement and jump penalties.
Bag throw distance multiplier: configurable slider (1.0x to 5.0x) to toss loot bags over security fences, across rooftops, or directly into extraction vehicles.
Full jump height: retains complete jumping elevation while carrying heavy loot bags for effortless vaulting over obstacles.
Bag damage absorption: configurable shield reduction absorbing incoming damage while actively hauling loot.

story.heading: Combat Hardening & Weapon Handling
items: Zero recoil & pin-point accuracy: completely eliminates vertical/horizontal recoil kick and zeroes bullet cone deviation for laser-precise firing.
Instant full-charge melee: delivers 100% full charged damage and maximum knockdown impulse on quick-tap melee attacks without holding the charge key.
Anti-flashbang shield: complete immunity against flashbang whiteout blinding screens, camera shake, and ear-ringing audio disorientation.
Full auto conversion: enables automatic fire mode toggling across semi-auto pistols, DMRs, and shotguns.

story.heading: Multiplayer Safe Mode & In-Game UI
items: Intelligent multiplayer Safe Mode: automatically disables gameplay-altering options when joining public multiplayer lobbies as a client to ensure fair, safe co-op play.
Custom in-game menu: fully modular SuperBLT in-game menu and keybind configuration with atomic disk persistence.

title: PhilNITS Lab
summary: An exam preparation platform for the Philippine National Information Technology Standards (PhilNITS / ITPEC) FE and IP examinations featuring automated computer vision OMR paper grading, interactive mock exams, and analytics.

story.heading: Computer Vision OMR Paper Grading
items: Perspective homography deskewing: automatically aligns and un-warps smartphone photos of printed A4 answer sheets.
BFS corner registration detection: scans fiduciary orientation markers to anchor coordinate grids for accurate alignment.
Bubble darkness evaluation: evaluates optical pixel fill density across answer matrices to score 80-question exams.

story.heading: Interactive Mock Exam Simulation
items: Timed mock environment: replicates authentic PhilNITS FE/IP examination pressure with countdown timers and pacing monitors.
Topic calibration & filtering: drill into specific ITPEC domains including algorithms, databases, networking, and system architecture.
Immediate rationale feedback: reveals comprehensive step-by-step explanations and confidence scoring post-submission.

story.heading: Performance Analytics & Weakness Detection
items: Domain breakdown radar: visualizes mastery distributions across discrete technical syllabus categories.
Historical performance tracking: maintains progression timelines, accuracy drift, and targeted review recommendations.

story.heading: Serverless Production Architecture & Offline Mode
items: Production-hardened Netlify Functions: serverless execution pipeline with zero local filesystem dependencies and fallback credentials.
Dual auth with guest mode: features GitHub OAuth backed by Supabase alongside a zero-friction guest mode for offline evaluation.

title: Lumen
summary: A fast, memory-safe desktop tool built with Rust and Tauri that identifies file types by scanning magic bytes, matches against 700+ signatures via SQLite, extracts containers, and inspects raw hex on demand.

story.heading: Binary Signature Engine & Offset Scanning
items: 700+ signature database: matches byte patterns against the Gary Kessler (GCK) File Signature Table indexed inside an embedded SQLite database.
Dual scanning modes: Quick Mode reads the initial 8KB targeting standard offsets (0, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, etc.), while Segmented Mode handles files >16MB in memory-safe overlapping chunks.

story.heading: Recursive Container Extraction & Disambiguation
items: Deep archive unpacking: unpacks ZIP, TAR, 7z (via native Rust crates), and RAR/CAB/ISO archives on demand.
Content-aware disambiguation: peeks into entry metadata for shared PK zip signatures (0x504B0304) to distinguish APK, EPUB, DOCX, and JAR formats.

story.heading: Interactive Hex Inspector & 5-Tab GUI
items: Hex visualization: dynamic byte viewer with arbitrary offset jumping, byte searching, and color-coded ASCII mapping.
5-tab modular workspace: dedicated views for single-file analysis, batch folder scanning, hex inspection, signature DB browser, and an embedded CLI terminal.

story.heading: Cross-Platform Tauri Architecture
items: Memory safety & native performance: core engine compiles to a headless Rust crate (lumen-engine) with zero GUI dependencies for fast CLI test execution.
Lightweight desktop packaging: ships as a compact MSI/EXE bundle powered by Tauri v2 and WebView2 with low idle memory overhead.

title: Yogurting OS Server & Launcher
summary: An open-source, asynchronous distributed game server engine for Yogurting Online built with .NET 8 and C#, replacing legacy Delphi systems with modern System.IO.Pipelines networking, reverse-engineered protocol handlers, and real-time AI.

story.heading: Distributed Multi-Daemon Topology
items: Decoupled daemon architecture: orchestrates LoginServer (10000), FieldServer (10002), EpisodeServer (10003), and CommServer (10004) concurrently across independent asynchronous event loops.
Zero-allocation packet processing: leverages System.IO.Pipelines to parse binary network packets and stream raw opcodes with minimal memory footprint.

story.heading: Protocol Reverse Engineering & Formula Parity
items: Binary disassembly & verification: reverse-engineered against original client PE binaries (LuGameEngineDX9.dll, Yogurting.exe) and DMS network grammars.
Accurate game formulas: achieves exact mathematical parity with legacy combat, weapon DEX scaling (Blade, Glove, Blunt, Spirit), critical hit calculations, and EXP tables.

story.heading: Spatial World & 4Hz Monster AI Loop
items: Campus map management: manages spatial instances across Estiva Academy, Soyul Middle School, and exterior hunting zones with warp gate portals.
Real-time AI state machine: dedicated 4Hz (250ms tick) loop handling aggro propagation, pursuit pathing, and field mob behaviors.

story.heading: Data-Driven Game Database
items: Automated tabular dataset parsing: dynamically deserializes 14,000+ items, 8,000+ reinforcement stones, 450+ fields, and 150+ episodes from 31 database tables.
Live interactive CLI: integrated administrative console with interactive commands for runtime inspecting, account creation, and world synchronization.
